resources.string: Net calories and active minutes are 7-day averages, to compare with the weight trend.
Calories and activity are averages per day for each week, to compare with the weight trend.
1. Set your goal weight. 2. Pick the date you want to reach it. 3. Self Watch works out a safe daily calorie goal. You can still change it.
You burn about %1$s kcal a day (%2$s). Eating %3$s kcal less loses about %4$s a week: %5$s kcal a day.
You burn about %1$s kcal a day (%2$s). Eating %3$s kcal more gains about %4$s a week: %5$s kcal a day.
You\'re at your goal weight. Eating what you burn (about %1$s kcal a day, %2$s) keeps it steady.
%1$s kcal a day is the safe minimum, and you burn about %2$s (%3$s), so food alone won\'t lower your weight. More activity will.
Raised to the safe minimum of %1$s kcal.
That date is too soon for a safe pace (at most 1%% of your weight a week to lose, 0.5%% to gain). The earliest safe date is %1$s.
